html:
We seek a detail-oriented and proactive Virtual Assistant & Affiliate Recruiter to manage reviews across various Online Travel Agencies (OTAs) and our market exposure.

Responsibilities:

1. Travel Booking & Management:

  • Book accommodations, flights, and other travel-related services on platforms like Airbnb, Booking.com, Expedia, and others.

  • Ensure all bookings align with client preferences, budgets, and schedules.

  • Manage reservations, modifications, and cancellations as needed.

2. Team Expansion & Recruitment:

  • Identify potential individuals who can assist with travel bookings.

  • Promote the opportunity to work as a travel assistant under a commission-based model.

  • Onboard and guide new team members on how to effectively book trips using OTAs.

  • Track and manage performance, ensuring successful transactions and client satisfaction.

Compensation:

  • Commission per successful booking.

  • Additional commission for every new team member recruited who completes bookings.

This role is ideal for someone with a passion for travel, networking, and remote work flexibility. If you thrive in a dynamic environment and enjoy helping others, apply now!
